questions.question: Which of the following international organizations approved a program to support women's employment in Tamil Nadu in 2025?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**World Bank (विश्व बैंक)**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **World Bank** Board of Executive Directors approved a **$200 million** (approximately **INR 1,600 crore**) loan in **early 2025** to support the **Tamil Nadu Women’s Employment and Enterprise Program (TN-WEEP)**.
 
• The primary objective of this program is to enhance **female labor force participation** by connecting women to high-growth and formal sector jobs in **Tamil Nadu**.
 
• The program specifically targets emerging industries such as **electronics**, **electric vehicles (EVs)**, **renewable energy**, and **non-leather footwear**, sectors where the state is currently a manufacturing leader.
 
• It aims to provide skills training and job placement support to more than **300,000 women**, helping them transition from informal work or unemployment to formal roles in **manufacturing** and **services**.
 
• A key feature of the project is the creation of **supportive infrastructure**, including the development of **childcare centers** and **safe transportation** options, which are often major barriers to women's employment.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Tamil Nadu’s Industrial Context**: **Tamil Nadu** is one of India's most industrialized states and currently accounts for nearly **40%** of India's **women factory workers**. The state government aims to become a **$1 trillion economy** by **2030**, and increasing the **women’s labor force participation rate (LFPR)** is a critical component of this goal.
 
• **World Bank Group Financing**: The funding for this project is provided by the **International Bank for Reconstruction and Development (IBRD)**. The loan has a **final maturity of 15 years**, which includes a **grace period of 5 years**, ensuring sustainable financial management for the state.
 
• **Support for Entrepreneurship**: Beyond direct employment, the **TN-WEEP** project will support **women-led MSMEs (Micro, Small, and Medium Enterprises)** by improving their access to **finance**, **market linkages**, and **business development services**.
 
• **World Bank Overview**: Headquartered in **Washington, D.C.**, the **World Bank** was established in **1944** at the **Bretton Woods Conference**. It currently consists of **189 member countries** and is headed by President **Ajay Banga** (as of 2024-2025).
 
• **Focus on Gender Equality**: This initiative aligns with the **World Bank Group Gender Strategy (2024-2030)**, which focuses on accelerating **gender equality** for a sustainable and inclusive future by removing barriers to women’s **economic empowerment**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Economic Impact**: Increasing **female participation** in the workforce is estimated to significantly boost the **Gross Domestic Product (GDP)**. In India, bridging the **gender gap** in the labor market could potentially add over **20%** to the national **GDP**.
 
• **Urban and Rural Reach**: The project will operate across both **urban** and **rural areas** of **Tamil Nadu**, focusing on districts that are becoming industrial hubs, such as **Kancheepuram**, **Hosur**, and **Coimbatore**.
 
• **Partnership with State Government**: The **Government of Tamil Nadu** will implement the project through its specialized agencies, ensuring that the **skilling modules** are aligned with the actual **demand of the industry**.
 
• **Sustainability**: The program emphasizes **Green Jobs**, training women for roles in **solar panel manufacturing** and the **electric vehicle ecosystem**, aligning with global **climate action** goals.

questions.question: Under the Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana (PMJDY), which major activity did the Reserve Bank of India mandate during July–September 2025?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Re-KYC of accounts**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Reserve Bank of India (RBI)** and the **Government of India** have mandated the **Re-KYC (Know Your Customer)** process for **Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana (PMJDY)** accounts to ensure they remain compliant with current regulatory standards.
 
• Since **PMJDY** was launched in **August 2014**, a vast majority of the accounts have reached the **10-year** mark. According to **RBI guidelines**, periodic updation of **KYC** documents for **low-risk** customers must be carried out at least once every **10 years**.
 
• The mandated activity for the **July-September 2025** period involves banks reaching out to account holders to update their **identity** and **address proofs** to prevent these accounts from becoming **inoperative** or restricted.
 
• Banks have been instructed to use various methods for this process, including **self-declaration** (if there is no change in information), **Video-Based Customer Identification Process (V-CIP)**, **ATMs**, and **Mobile Banking** to minimize inconvenience to the account holders. ***Hence, the mandate for Re-KYC of accounts is correct.***
 
• This drive is essential for maintaining the **integrity** of the financial system and ensuring that **Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT)** credits continue to reach the intended beneficiaries without technical glitches.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana (PMJDY):**

 
 
• Launched on **August 28, 2014**, it is a **National Mission for Financial Inclusion** aimed at providing affordable access to financial services like **savings accounts**, **remittance**, **credit**, **insurance**, and **pensions**.
 
• It allows for the opening of **Basic Savings Bank Deposit (BSBD)** accounts with **zero balance** requirements, ensuring that even the poorest sections of society can access banking.
 
 
 
• **Key Features and Benefits:**
 
 
• Every account holder is provided with a **RuPay Debit Card**.
 
• Accounts opened after **August 28, 2018**, come with an enhanced **Accident Insurance Cover** of **Rs. 2 lakh** (it was **Rs. 1 lakh** for accounts opened before this date).
 
• An **Overdraft (OD)** facility of up to **Rs. 10,000** is available to eligible account holders, particularly targeting the **lady of the household** to promote **financial empowerment**.
 
 
 
• **Significance of KYC:**
 
 
• **KYC** is a process used by financial institutions to verify the identity and suitability of their clients. It is crucial for preventing **money laundering**, **identity theft**, and **financial fraud**.
 
• Under the **Prevention of Money Laundering Act (PMLA), 2002**, banks are legally obligated to maintain updated records of their customers.
 
 
 
• **Inoperative Accounts:**
 
 
• A **PMJDY** account is treated as **inoperative** if there are no customer-induced transactions in the account for over **two years**. Regular **re-KYC** helps in identifying active versus dormant accounts.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Official Documents (OVDs):** For the **re-KYC** process, customers can use any of the six **Officially Valid Documents**: **Aadhaar Card**, **Voter ID**, **Passport**, **Driving License**, **MNREGA Job Card**, or **PAN Card**.
 
• **Financial Inclusion Progress:** As of **2024**, more than **50 crore** PMJDY accounts have been opened with total deposits exceeding **Rs. 2 lakh crore**, signifying the massive scale of this **financial inclusion** initiative in **India**.
 
• **Digital Push:** The **RBI** has emphasized that if a customer has already submitted their **Aadhaar** and there is no change in their **residential address**, they should not be required to visit the branch physically for **re-KYC**.

questions.question: In 2024, which of the following Indian scientists was honored with the COSPAR Harry Massey Award?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Prahlad Chandra Agrawal**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Professor **Prahlad Chandra Agrawal** (P.C. Agrawal) was honored with the prestigious **COSPAR Harrie Massey Award** in **2024**.
 
• The award was conferred during the **45th Scientific Assembly** of the **Committee on Space Research (COSPAR)**, which took place in **Busan, South Korea**, in **July 2024**.
 
• He is recognized for his outstanding contributions to **space research**, particularly his leadership in the development of **AstroSat**, which is **India's first dedicated multi-wavelength space observatory** launched by **ISRO**.
 
• **P.C. Agrawal** is a former professor at the **Tata Institute of Fundamental Research (TIFR)** and has spent decades advancing the field of **high-energy astrophysics** and **X-ray astronomy** in India.
 
• He played a pivotal role as the **Principal Investigator** for the **Large Area X-ray Proportional Counter (LAXPC)**, one of the primary instruments on **AstroSat**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **COSPAR (Committee on Space Research)**:

 
 
• It was established by the **International Council of Scientific Unions (ICSU)** in **1958** to promote scientific research in space at an international level.
 
• The organization facilitates the exchange of results, information, and opinions among scientists globally.
 
 
 
• **Harrie Massey Award**:
 
 
• This award honors the memory of **Sir Harrie Massey**, a distinguished **Australian physicist** who made significant contributions to atomic physics and space research.
 
• It is awarded to individuals who have shown **outstanding leadership** and made significant contributions to the advancement of **space science**.
 
 
 
• **AstroSat**:
 
 
• Launched on **September 28, 2015**, using the **PSLV-C30** launch vehicle, **AstroSat** provides a unique capability to observe the universe in **Ultraviolet, Optical, and X-ray** bands simultaneously.
 
• It has enabled Indian scientists to study **black holes**, **neutron stars**, and **binary star systems** with high precision.
 
 
 
• **Other Notable Scientists**:
 
 
• **Udupi Ramachandra Rao**: A former **ISRO Chairman** known as the "Satellite Man of India," he was the first Indian to be inducted into the **Satellite Hall of Fame**.
 
• **K. Radhakrishnan**: He served as the **Chairman of ISRO** during the successful **Mars Orbiter Mission (Mangalyaan)** in **2014**.
 
• **G. Madhavan Nair**: He was the **ISRO Chairman** during the launch of **Chandrayaan-1** in **2008**, India's first mission to the Moon.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• The **COSPAR 2024** assembly marked a significant moment for Indian space science as **Professor Agrawal** became one of the few Indian scientists to receive this high international honor.
 
• His work bridges the gap between **instrumentation** and **theoretical astrophysics**, ensuring that India remains a key player in the **global space science community**.
 
• The **LAXPC instrument** developed under his guidance is capable of studying rapid **X-ray variability** in celestial sources, providing data that is used by researchers worldwide.

questions.question: Which film won the Best Film award at the 25th IIFA Awards held in March 2025?

questions.question: Who became the first male field athlete to win the Laureus World Sportsman of the Year award in April 2025?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Armand Duplantis**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Armand "Mondo" Duplantis**, representing **Sweden**, was honored as the **Laureus World Sportsman of the Year** in **April 2025**.
 
• He achieved a historic milestone by becoming the **first male field athlete** to win this prestigious global award since its inception.
 
• The award recognized his unprecedented dominance in the **Pole Vault** event throughout the **2024** season, where he consistently broke his own **World Record** and secured the **Gold Medal** at the **Paris Olympics**.
 
• During the qualifying period, Duplantis pushed the boundaries of human achievement, clearing a height of **6.26 meters**, further cementing his legacy as one of the greatest athletes in history.
 
• His victory broke the long-standing trend of the award being predominantly won by athletes from **Tennis**, **Football**, or **Formula 1**, highlighting the rising profile of **field events** in international sports.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Laureus World Sports Awards:**

 
 
• Established in **1999** by founding patrons **Daimler** and **Richemont**, these awards are often referred to as the "**Oscars of Sport**."
 
• The first ceremony was held in **2000** in **Monte Carlo**, with **Tiger Woods** being the inaugural winner of the Sportsman of the Year title.
 
• Winners are selected by the **Laureus World Sports Academy**, a jury comprising over **70 sporting legends**.
 
 
 
• **Jakob Ingebrigtsen:**
 
 
• A **Norwegian** middle-distance and long-distance runner who specializes in the **1500m** and **5000m**.
 
• He won the **Olympic Gold** in the **5000m** at the **2024 Paris Games** and holds multiple **European** and **World** records in distance running.
 
 
 
• **Neeraj Chopra:**
 
 
• The "Golden Boy" of **India**, who is a specialist in the **Javelin Throw**.
 
• After winning **Gold** at the **Tokyo 2020 Olympics**, he secured a **Silver Medal** at the **2024 Paris Olympics** and has been a frequent nominee for Laureus awards due to his massive impact on **Asian athletics**.
 
 
 
• **Max Verstappen:**
 
 
• A **Dutch** racing driver who competes in **Formula 1** for **Red Bull Racing**.
 
• He has won multiple consecutive **World Drivers' Championships** (**2021, 2022, 2023**) and previously won the **Laureus World Sportsman of the Year** award in **2022**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• The **2025 Laureus Ceremony** celebrated the best of **2024**, which was an **Olympic year**, making the competition for the top honors exceptionally high among global icons.
 
• The distinction between **track athletes** (runners) and **field athletes** (jumpers/throwers) is significant in athletics history; Duplantis's win is a rare recognition for the **jumping disciplines**.
 
• Duplantis holds both the **Indoor** and **Outdoor** world records, making him the most decorated **Pole Vaulter** in the modern era, surpassing the records of legend **Sergey Bubka**.

questions.question: According to the Union Budget 2025-26, how much borrowing is planned to be raised through gross market borrowing in the financial year 2025-26?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**₹14.82 lakh crore**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Union Budget 2025-26** was presented by the **Union Minister for Finance and Corporate Affairs**, **Smt. Nirmala Sitharaman**, in **Parliament** on **February 1, 2025**.
 
• According to the budget estimates, the **gross market borrowing** through dated securities for the financial year **2025-26** is planned at **₹14.82 lakh crore**.
 
• This borrowing is part of the government's strategy to finance the **Fiscal Deficit** while ensuring that the **private sector** has enough space for credit as the economy grows.
 
• The **net market borrowing** for the same period (FY 2025-26) is estimated to be **₹11.23 lakh crore**, which is the amount borrowed after accounting for the repayment of past loans.
 
• The fiscal deficit for **2025-26** is estimated at **4.3%** of the **Gross Domestic Product (GDP)**, showing a continued commitment to the **fiscal consolidation glide path**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Capital Expenditure (Capex):**

 
 
• The **Capital Expenditure** outlay for **2025-26** has been increased to **₹12.01 lakh crore**.
 
• This represents a significant portion of the total budget, aimed at boosting **infrastructure**, **logistics**, and **industrial growth** across the **country**.
 
• Higher Capex is expected to have a **multiplier effect** on the **economy**, creating **employment** and improving long-term productivity.
 
 
 
• **Total Expenditure and Receipts:**
 
 
• The **total expenditure** for the financial year **2025-26** is estimated at **₹53.07 lakh crore**.
 
• The **total receipts** (other than borrowings) are estimated at **₹34.40 lakh crore**.
 
• The **Gross Tax Revenue** is expected to see steady growth, driven by **GST (Goods and Services Tax)**, **Direct Taxes**, and **Corporate Taxes**.
 
 
 
• **Fiscal Consolidation:**
 
 
• The government aims to reach a **fiscal deficit** level below **4.5%** by the year **2025-26**.
 
• By targeting **4.3%** in this budget, the government is successfully adhering to the **Medium-Term Fiscal Policy** framework.
 
• Managing **market borrowings** effectively is crucial to maintain **macroeconomic stability** and keep **inflation** within the target range set by the **RBI (Reserve Bank of India)**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Market Borrowing Mechanism:** The **Government of India** borrows from the domestic market by issuing **Dated Securities** and **Treasury Bills**. The **RBI** acts as the investment manager for the government.
 
• **Dated Securities:** These are long-term **debt instruments** that carry a fixed or floating **coupon rate** (interest rate) paid on the face value, with a **tenure** ranging from **5 years to 40 years**.
 
• **Significance of the Figures:** The planned **₹14.82 lakh crore** gross borrowing is manageable and was well-received by the **bond market**, as it indicates that the government is not over-leveraging despite high **expenditure** needs.
 
• **Comparison:** In the **Interim Budget 2024-25**, the gross borrowing was pegged at **₹14.13 lakh crore**, showing a marginal and calibrated increase for the **2025-26** full budget to support **developmental goals**.

questions.question: Chhannulal Mishra, who passed away in October 2025, was known for his contributions in which of the following fields?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**हिंदुस्तानी शास्त्रीय संगीत (Hindustani Classical Music)**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Pandit Chhannulal Mishra** was a legendary doyen of **Hindustani Classical Music**, specifically representing the **Kirana Gharana** and the **Banaras Gharana** of **Varanasi**.
 
• He was renowned for his unique ability to perform a wide range of musical genres, including **Khayal**, **Thumri**, **Dadra**, **Kajri**, **Chaiti**, and **Bhajans**.
 
• Born on **August 3, 1936**, in **Hariharpur**, **Azamgarh** district of **Uttar Pradesh**, he moved to **Varanasi** to dedicate his life to the spiritual and classical musical traditions of the holy city.
 
• In recognition of his unparalleled contribution to the arts, he was honored with the **Padma Vibhushan**, India's second-highest civilian award, in the year **2020**.
 
• His passing in **October 2025** marked the end of an era for the **Purab-Ang Gayaki**, a specialized style of singing prevalent in eastern **Uttar Pradesh**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Musical Lineage and Training:**

 
 
• He received his initial training from his father, **Badri Prasad Mishra**, and later refined his skills under the guidance of **Ustad Abdul Ghani Khan** of the **Kirana Gharana**.
 
• He was also a disciple of **Thakur Jaidev Singh**, who was a great musicologist and philosopher, helping **Chhannulal Mishra** integrate deep spiritual meaning into his renditions.
 
 
 
• **The Banaras Style (Gayaki):**
 
 
• The **Banaras Gharana** is famous for its semi-classical forms like **Thumri** and **Dadra**. Pandit Mishra was often called the "King of Thumri" for his emotive and soulful expressions.
 
• His repertoire also included **Ramcharitmanas** recitals, where he would sing verses in classical ragas, making the epic accessible to common people while maintaining technical purity.
 
 
 
• **Major Awards and Honors:**
 
 
• **Padma Bhushan**: Awarded in **2010** for his distinguished service in the field of **Classical Music**.
 
• **Sangeet Natak Akademi Award**: Conferred in **2000** by India's National Academy of Music, Dance & Drama.
 
• **Yash Bharti Award**: Conferred by the Government of **Uttar Pradesh** for his cultural impact on the state.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Cultural Impact:** **Pandit Chhannulal Mishra** was instrumental in preserving the **Kajri** (monsoon songs) and **Hori** (songs for Holi), ensuring these folk-classical traditions were showcased on global platforms.
 
• **Discography and Performance:** He performed at various national and international festivals, including the **Sankat Mochan Sangeet Samaroh** in **Varanasi** and the **Sawai Gandharva Bhimsen Mahotsav** in **Pune**.
 
• **Spiritual Connection:** A staunch devotee of Lord **Rama**, his most famous **Bhajans** such as "Jab Se Ram Naam Kahal" and "Balam Re" are considered masterpieces of devotional **Hindustani Classical Music**.
 
• **Legacy:** He is survived by a rich legacy of students and recordings that continue to serve as a textbook for learners of the **Banaras style** of singing.

questions.question: By how many places has India improved its ranking in the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) in the 2025 edition of the Sustainable Development Report compared to 2024?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**10**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Sustainable Development Report (SDR)** is an annual assessment that tracks the progress of all **193 UN Member States** toward achieving the **Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs)**.
 
• In the **2025 edition** of the report, **India** demonstrated a significant advancement by improving its global ranking by **10 positions** compared to the **2024** data.
 
• This improvement reflects **India’s** concerted efforts in areas such as **climate action (Goal 13)**, **clean energy (Goal 7)**, and **sustainable cities (Goal 11)**, which have seen measurable positive shifts in the latest reporting cycle.
 
• The report is published by the **Sustainable Development Solutions Network (SDSN)**, which has been operating under the auspices of the **UN Secretary-General** since **2012**.
 
• The **2025 ranking** highlights that while **India** still faces challenges in **gender equality (Goal 5)** and **hunger (Goal 2)**, the overall trajectory has moved upward, moving the nation closer to the median ranking of **developing economies**. ***Hence, the correct answer is 10.***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs):**

 
 
• The **SDGs**, also known as the **Global Goals**, were adopted by the **United Nations** in **September 2015** as a universal call to action to end poverty and protect the planet.
 
• There are **17 Goals** and **169 targets** intended to be reached by the year **2030**.
 
• These goals replaced the **Millennium Development Goals (MDGs)** which ended in **2015**.
 
 
 
• **NITI Aayog’s SDG India Index:**
 
 
• At the national level, **NITI Aayog** is the nodal agency responsible for monitoring **SDG** implementation through the **SDG India Index**.
 
• The index ranks **States** and **Union Territories** based on their performance, categorizing them as **Aspirants**, **Performers**, **Front-Runners**, or **Achievers**.
 
• The latest **SDG India Index 2023-24** showed that **Kerala** and **Uttarakhand** emerged as top-performing states.
 
 
 
• **SDSN and Global Monitoring:**

questions.question: On which date has ‘National Space Day’ been declared in India?
questions.solution:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• India celebrates **National Space Day** on **23 August** every year to commemorate the successful landing of the **Chandrayaan-3** mission.
 
• On **23 August 2023**, the **Vikram lander** of the **Chandrayaan-3** mission successfully touched down on the **Lunar South Pole**.
 
• Prime Minister **Narendra Modi** made the official announcement of this day during his visit to the **ISRO Telemetry Tracking and Command Network (ISTRAC)** in **Bengaluru** on **August 26, 2023**.
 
• With this achievement, India became the **fourth** country in the world to land a spacecraft on the **Moon** and the **first** ever to land near the **Southern Polar region** of the lunar surface.
 
• The landing site of the **Chandrayaan-3** lander was named **'Shiv Shakti Point'**, symbolizing the connection between humanity and the celestial bodies. ***Hence, the correct option is 23 अगस्त.***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **11 मई (11 May):**

 
 
• This date is celebrated as **National Technology Day** in India.
 
• It marks the anniversary of the **Pokhran-II** nuclear tests conducted in **1998** under the leadership of then Prime Minister **Atal Bihari Vajpayee**.
 
• It highlights the achievements of **Indian scientists** and engineers in the field of **science and technology**.
 
 
 
• **20 जुलाई (20 July):**
 
 
• This date is recognized globally as **International Moon Day**.
 
• It commemorates the anniversary of the first human landing on the **Moon** by the **Apollo 11** mission in **1969**, where **Neil Armstrong** and **Buzz Aldrin** walked on the lunar surface.
 
 
 
• **28 फरवरी (28 February):**
 
 
• This date is celebrated as **National Science Day** in India.
 
• It commemorates the discovery of the **'Raman Effect'** by the renowned Indian physicist **Sir C.V. Raman** on **28 February 1928**.
 
• For this discovery, **Sir C.V. Raman** was awarded the **Nobel Prize in Physics** in **1930**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

• The mission was launched on **14 July 2023** using the **LVM3-M4** rocket from the **Satish Dhawan Space Centre** in **Sriharikota**.
 
• The mission components included a **Propulsion Module**, the **Vikram Lander**, and the **Pragyan Rover**.
 
• The **rover** performed various experiments on the lunar surface to study the **chemical composition** and **mineralogy** of the **South Pole**.
 
 
 
• **Naming of Lunar Sites:**
 
 
• Apart from **Shiv Shakti Point**, the Prime Minister also named the spot where **Chandrayaan-2** left its hard-landing footprints in **2019** as **'Tiranga Point'**.
 
 
 
• **Theme of First National Space Day:**
 
 
• The theme for the maiden **National Space Day** celebrated in **2024** was **"Touching Lives while Touching the Moon: India's Space Saga"**.
 
• The **Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO)** was founded on **15 August 1969** and is currently headquartered in **Bengaluru**, **Karnataka**.
